intended_object: A specific numerical constant, 16 · lowKernelDerivativeConstant · 2^(2B). It is the explicit Calderón–Zygmund regularity bound for the library's "low kernel" at height B, inferred from the docstring and from how the library uses it.
explanation: This definition is only a named real number. It records the bound produced by one step of the proof: the kernel regularity estimate |K(x,y) − K(x,z)| ≤ C_B·|y − z|/|x − y|² proved in the same file. The library then passes this constant to a Calderón–Zygmund lemma, together with a proof that it is nonnegative. The literature has no standard object with this exact value. It is bookkeeping inside the proof, so there is nothing to check it against beyond the theorems that use it, and those compile.
